name: Convex-Treelike Product Theorem
statement: For finite partial cubes $G,H$, the product $G\square H$ belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ if and only if both factors do.
proof: Each factor is a convex subgraph of the product. Conversely, recursively expand one factor while holding the other fixed, then induct on the two peripheral expansion trees.
